page.overview:
What is Sweet Amber?

Sweet Amber is the eighth song off of Metallica's eighth studio album, St. Anger.

The meaning of Sweet amber is about a toxic relationship with alcohol and addiction. In addition to being a girl's name, Amber is also the color of many beers, leading many listeners to determine that the song deals with James Hetfield's past addition to alcohol, specifically beer. Instead, the title of the metaphorical gem in the narrator’s mind would go to the alcohol mentioned throughout the song.
